items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: I’m in the process of doing with my band who is Amy Bowles, Aaron Bellamy

ctx.x: What are your goals right now.
My immediate goals is to record my next album, which I’m in the process of doing with my band who is Amy Bowles, Aaron Bellamy, the band you saw in Utica basically. I think they were all there.
